## Summary
- only merge projected sound embeddings when the batch carries authenticated audio inputs
- preserve generated occurrences of the sound-token vocabulary ID as ordinary text in image-only/text-only batches
- add a regression test for an image-only input containing that ordinary token ID

## Validation
- targeted Nemotron Omni regression test passed
- validated in a 4-node NeMo RL OSWorld smoke through rollout, old-policy logprobs, optimizer/refit, and `step_1` checkpoint

Signed-off-by: Linglin Jing <linglinj@cw-dfw-cs-001-vscode-01.cm.cluster>

detail.body:
## Summary
- only merge projected sound embeddings when the batch carries authenticated audio inputs
- preserve generated occurrences of the sound-token vocabulary ID as ordinary text in image-only/text-only batches
- add a regression test for an image-only input containing that ordinary token ID

## Validation
- targeted Nemotron Omni regression test passed
- validated in a 4-node NeMo RL OSWorld smoke through rollout, old-policy logprobs, optimizer/refit, and `step_1` checkpoint

Signed-off-by: Linglin Jing <linglinj@cw-dfw-cs-001-vscode-01.cm.cluster>
detail.title: fix(nemotron-omni): gate sound merge on audio inputs

files.patch:
@@ -885,9 +885,12 @@ def forward(
                 media_token_validity_mask,
             )
 
-            if self.sound_token_index > 0:
-                if sound_embeddings is None:
-                    sound_embeddings = combined_embeddings.new_empty((0, combined_embeddings.shape[-1]))
+            # ``sound_token_index`` is an ordinary vocabulary id.  In an
+            # image-only/text-only batch it may therefore occur in generated
+            # prose without denoting an audio anchor.  Audio provenance, not
+            # the token id alone, decides whether sound insertion runs.
+            if self.sound_token_index > 0 and has_sound_inputs:
+                assert sound_embeddings is not None
                 combined_embeddings = self._merge_projected_media(
                     combined_embeddings,
                     input_ids,

@@ -857,6 +857,21 @@ def test_audio_forward_replaces_expanded_placeholders_without_changing_length():
     assert torch.equal(output[3, 0], torch.tensor([9.0, 9.0, 9.0]))
 
 
+def test_image_only_forward_preserves_ordinary_sound_token():
+    image_features = torch.tensor([[101.0, 102.0, 103.0]])
+    model = _BoundaryModel(image_features)
+    input_ids = torch.tensor([[7, 18, 19, 9]])
+
+    output = model(
+        input_ids=input_ids,
+        attention_mask=torch.ones_like(input_ids, dtype=torch.bool),
+        images=torch.ones(1),
+    )
+
+    assert torch.equal(output[1, 0], image_features[0])
+    assert torch.equal(output[2, 0], torch.tensor([19.0, 19.0, 19.0]))
+
+
 def test_sound_encoder_drops_padded_rows_and_preserves_sample_order():
     model = _SoundEncoderBoundaryModel()
